_metadata.name: JAIN (Deemed-to-be University) - Faculty of Engineering & Technology (FET)
_metadata.address: Jakkasandra Post, Kanakapura Taluk, Ramanagara District, Karnataka, India - 562112
_metadata.disclaimer: Digital twin dataset combining verified OpenStreetMap campus boundary coordinates, satellite imagery layout geometry, and official JAIN University FET 5-Floor Fire Escape Route Plans. Indoor layouts accurately reflect the physical annular building and room sequences. Cartesian coordinates are schematic layout coordinates, not land-surveyed GPS coordinates.

buildings.name: Faculty of Engineering and Technology (FET)
buildings.description: Primary engineering complex with 5 levels, central amphitheater courtyard, and 4 radial wings.

buildings.name: The Colosseum (Indoor Sports Arena & Hall)
buildings.description: Grand multi-purpose sports pavilion, convocation hall, and indoor badminton/basketball courts.

buildings.name: International Cricket Stadium & Pavilion
buildings.description: Standard oval cricket pitch with seating pavilions and athletic tracks.

buildings.name: JIRS Swimming Pool & Aquatic Complex
buildings.description: 50m Olympic competition pool, diving platforms, and changing rooms.

buildings.name: SBMJCE Dining Complex & Cafeteria
buildings.description: Central student & staff food court with indoor dining hall and terrace seating.

buildings.name: Student Residential Hostels & Quarters
buildings.description: Multi-storey student accommodation blocks with courtyards and amenities.

buildings.name: Administration & Student Affairs Block
buildings.description: Administrative headquarters, admissions office, and university council chambers.

buildings.name: Aerospace Research & Propulsion Center
buildings.description: Aeronautical engineering testing hangars, wind tunnels, and UAV flight labs.
